items.headline: Strategic chokepoint control gives Iran upper hand in diplomatic negotiations with Washington.
items.teaser: Iran's strategic position over the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway for global oil trade, could potentially force the United States …
items.story:
Iran's strategic position over the Strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway for global oil trade, could potentially force the United States back to negotiations, according to Cyrus Schayegh, Professor of International History and Politics at the Geneva Graduate Institute. The Strait of Hormuz is a vital shipping lane, with a significant portion of the world's oil passing through it, giving Iran considerable leverage in the region. This leverage, combined with pressure from Gulf states, may prompt the US to reconsider its stance on negotiations with Iran. The US has been seeking to exert pressure on Iran through economic sanctions and diplomatic isolation, but Iran's control over the Strait of Hormuz provides it with a significant bargaining chip.

The current tensions between the US and Iran are part of a long-standing complex history of relations between the two countries, dating back to the 1979 Iranian Revolution. The US has imposed stringent sanctions on Iran, targeting its oil exports and banking sector, in an effort to curb its nuclear program and regional influence. However, Iran has continued to maintain its position, refusing to back down in the face of international pressure. The Strait of Hormuz has been a focal point of tensions, with Iran threatening to disrupt oil shipments through the waterway in response to US sanctions. This has raised concerns among Gulf states and other countries reliant on oil exports, which could potentially push the US to reconsider its approach.

According to Schayegh, Iran's leverage over the Strait of Hormuz, combined with the pressure from Gulf states, could create an opportunity for the US to re-engage in negotiations with Iran. The US has been seeking to build a coalition of countries to counter Iran's influence in the region, but the complexities of the situation may require a more nuanced approach. Iran's ability to disrupt oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz could have significant economic implications, making it a critical issue for the US and other countries to address. The US has been exploring options to mitigate the impact of any potential disruptions, but a negotiated settlement may be the most effective way to resolve the situation.

The potential for the US to return to negotiations with Iran has been met with a mix of reactions from stakeholders in the region. Gulf states, which are heavily reliant on oil exports, are likely to welcome any efforts to reduce tensions and ensure the free flow of oil through the Strait of Hormuz. However, other countries, such as Israel, may be more skeptical of any attempts to negotiate with Iran, given concerns about its nuclear program and regional influence. The international community is watching the situation closely, with many countries calling for a peaceful resolution to the tensions between the US and Iran.

The situation in the Strait of Hormuz has significant implications for global oil markets and the broader region. Any disruptions to oil shipments through the waterway could have a major impact on the global economy, making it a critical issue for countries around the world to address. The US, in particular, has a significant interest in maintaining the free flow of oil through the Strait of Hormuz, given its own reliance on imported oil. The situation is also closely tied to other regional developments, including the conflict in Yemen and the ongoing tensions between Iran and its neighbors.

As the situation continues to unfold, it remains to be seen whether the US will indeed return to negotiations with Iran. The US has been exploring a range of options to address the situation, including building a coalition of countries to counter Iran's influence in the region. However, the complexities of the situation may require a more nuanced approach, taking into account the interests and concerns of all stakeholders involved. The international community will be watching the situation closely, as the US and Iran navigate a potentially critical juncture in their relations, with significant implications for the region and the world.

items.headline: Kenyan asylum seeker deported from South Africa amidst escalating xenophobic community unrest.
items.teaser: Simon Chege Wanjiru, a Kenyan migrant, was forced to leave South Africa after spending over two decades building a life in the country, d…
items.story:
Simon Chege Wanjiru, a Kenyan migrant, was forced to leave South Africa after spending over two decades building a life in the country, due to the recent wave of anti-migrant protests and attacks. Wanjiru had established a successful business and raised a family in South Africa, but the increasing violence and hostility towards migrants made it impossible for him to stay. The protests, which have been ongoing for several weeks, have resulted in the displacement of thousands of migrants, with many being forced to flee the country. Wanjiru's story is just one example of the many migrants who have been affected by the violence and intimidation. He has now returned to Kenya, leaving behind his family and business, and is struggling to come to terms with the sudden disruption to his life.

The recent anti-migrant protests in South Africa are not an isolated incident, but rather part of a larger pattern of xenophobic violence that has been ongoing for several years. The country has a long history of tensions between native South Africans and migrants, with many South Africans blaming migrants for taking their jobs and resources. The situation has been exacerbated by the country's economic struggles, with high levels of unemployment and poverty contributing to the resentment towards migrants. The South African government has been criticized for not doing enough to address the issue, with many arguing that more needs to be done to protect the rights of migrants and promote social cohesion.

According to official estimates, over 10,000 migrants have been displaced by the recent violence, with many more feared to be at risk. The United Nations has condemned the attacks, calling on the South African government to take immediate action to protect the rights of migrants. The African Union has also weighed in, expressing concern over the violence and calling for greater regional cooperation to address the root causes of the problem. Meanwhile, migrant organizations have reported a significant increase in attacks and intimidation, with many migrants living in fear of their lives. The situation remains volatile, with many migrants uncertain about their future in South Africa.

The impact of the anti-migrant protests has been felt far beyond South Africa's borders, with many countries in the region expressing concern over the situation. The Kenyan government, in particular, has been vocal in its criticism of the South African government's handling of the crisis, with many Kenyans calling for greater protection for their citizens living in South Africa. The crisis has also had economic implications, with trade between South Africa and other African countries likely to be affected by the instability. As the situation continues to unfold, many are watching with concern, wondering what the long-term consequences will be for regional relations and economic stability.

The wider context of the anti-migrant protests in South Africa is complex and multifaceted, reflecting deeper social and economic issues that need to be addressed. The country's history of apartheid and segregation has created a legacy of social and economic inequality, which has contributed to the tensions between native South Africans and migrants. Additionally, the country's economic struggles, including high levels of unemployment and poverty, have created an environment in which migrants are often scapegoated for the country's problems. To address the issue, the South African government will need to take a comprehensive approach, addressing the root causes of the violence and promoting social cohesion and economic development.

As the situation in South Africa continues to evolve, many are wondering what the future holds for migrants like Simon Chege Wanjiru, who have been forced to leave the country. The Kenyan government has announced plans to provide support to its citizens who have been displaced by the violence, but it remains to be seen how effective these efforts will be. Meanwhile, the international community is watching with concern, calling on the South African government to take action to protect the rights of migrants and promote social cohesion. As the crisis continues to unfold, one thing is clear: a comprehensive and sustainable solution will be needed to address the complex social and economic issues that have contributed to the violence.

items.story:
Heat pumps are gaining popularity in the United States, with their efficiency and environmentally friendly features making them an attractive option for homeowners and businesses. The appliances, which use electricity for heating, are becoming increasingly common, particularly in regions with mild winters. As the country experiences record-breaking heat waves, the demand for energy-efficient heating solutions is on the rise. According to industry experts, heat pumps are poised to play a significant role in reducing the nation's carbon footprint.

The concept of heat pumps is not new, with the technology having been around for decades. However, advancements in design and functionality have made them more efficient and cost-effective, leading to a surge in adoption. Historically, heat pumps have been used in regions with mild climates, but their popularity is now spreading to other areas. The US government has also taken notice, with initiatives aimed at promoting the use of heat pumps as a sustainable alternative to traditional heating systems. As a result, the market for heat pumps is expected to continue growing, driven by increasing demand for energy-efficient solutions.

Data from the US Department of Energy shows that heat pumps can reduce energy consumption by up to 50% compared to traditional heating systems. Additionally, heat pumps can provide both heating and cooling, making them a versatile option for homeowners. Industry leaders, such as the Air-Conditioning, Heating, Refrigeration Certification Board, have also weighed in, stating that heat pumps are a critical component in the transition to a more sustainable energy future. With the average American household spending over $1,000 on energy bills annually, the potential savings offered by heat pumps are significant.

The growing demand for heat pumps is having a positive impact on the market, with manufacturers reporting increased sales and revenue. Homeowners and businesses are also benefiting from the energy-efficient features of heat pumps, with many reporting significant reductions in their energy bills. Furthermore, the shift towards heat pumps is creating new job opportunities in the installation and maintenance sectors. As the market continues to expand, stakeholders are eagerly awaiting the development of new technologies and innovations that will further improve the efficiency and affordability of heat pumps.

The rise of heat pumps in the US is also part of a broader global trend, with countries around the world investing in sustainable energy solutions. The International Energy Agency has reported that heat pumps can play a critical role in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and mitigating the impacts of climate change. As the world transitions towards a more sustainable energy future, the demand for heat pumps is likely to continue growing. Regional initiatives, such as the European Union's renewable energy targets, are also driving the adoption of heat pumps, with many countries setting ambitious goals for the deployment of sustainable heating solutions.

As the US continues to experience extreme weather events, the importance of energy-efficient heating solutions like heat pumps will only continue to grow. With the Biden administration's focus on promoting sustainable energy solutions, the market for heat pumps is likely to receive further support and investment. As the industry looks to the future, key questions remain, including how to address the upfront costs associated with heat pump installation and how to ensure that the benefits of heat pumps are equitably distributed across different regions and socioeconomic groups. As the market continues to evolve, stakeholders will be watching closely to see how these challenges are addressed and how heat pumps will contribute to a more sustainable energy future.

items.story:
Lululemon, the Canadian athletic apparel company, has invested in Syntetica, a French startup that specializes in recycling nylon, as part of a $30 million Series A funding round. This significant investment underscores the growing importance of sustainable practices in the fashion industry. Syntetica's innovative approach to recycling nylon has already garnered attention from major players in the sector. The company's technology has the potential to significantly reduce waste and promote the use of recycled materials in clothing production.

The development of Syntetica's nylon-recycling technology is a notable step forward in the quest for more sustainable fashion practices. Nylon is a widely used material in the production of athletic wear and outdoor gear, but its recycling has traditionally been a challenging and costly process. Syntetica's novel approach aims to make nylon recycling more efficient and cost-effective, which could have a significant impact on the environmental footprint of the fashion industry. The company's partnership with Lululemon and other big-name investors is a testament to the growing recognition of the need for sustainable practices in the sector.

According to official statements, Syntetica's Series A funding round was led by a consortium of investors, including Lululemon, and will be used to further develop the company's technology and expand its operations. The investment is seen as a strategic move by Lululemon to reduce its environmental impact and promote sustainable practices throughout its supply chain. Syntetica's technology has the potential to recycle a significant proportion of the world's nylon waste, which could have a major impact on the reduction of plastic waste and the promotion of circular economy practices.

The investment in Syntetica has been welcomed by industry observers, who see it as a positive step towards a more sustainable future for the fashion industry. The partnership between Lululemon and Syntetica is expected to drive innovation and adoption of sustainable practices in the sector, and could potentially inspire other companies to follow suit. The move is also seen as a reflection of the growing consumer demand for sustainable and environmentally responsible products, and the need for companies to respond to this demand in order to remain competitive.

The development of Syntetica's nylon-recycling technology is part of a broader trend towards sustainable practices in the fashion industry. In recent years, there has been a growing recognition of the need for companies to reduce their environmental impact and promote circular economy practices. The investment in Syntetica is one of several initiatives aimed at reducing waste and promoting the use of recycled materials in clothing production. Other companies, such as Patagonia and Reformation, have also made significant investments in sustainable practices and environmentally responsible supply chains.

As the fashion industry continues to evolve and respond to growing consumer demand for sustainable products, it is likely that we will see further investment in innovative technologies and practices. The partnership between Lululemon and Syntetica is a significant step forward in this direction, and it will be interesting to see how the company's technology develops and is adopted by other players in the sector. With the global fashion industry facing increasing pressure to reduce its environmental impact, the development of sustainable practices and technologies is likely to remain a key area of focus in the years to come.

items.story:
Researchers at New York University have made a significant breakthrough in solving the perplexing "reverse sprinkler" problem, a physics puzzle that had stumped renowned physicist Richard Feynman. The problem, which involves understanding the motion of a sprinkler when its water supply is reversed, has been a subject of debate among physicists for decades. According to the researchers, their solution not only applies to the reverse sprinkler but also to "silly sprinklers," which are sprinklers with an off-center axis of rotation. The findings have been widely reported and are considered a major advancement in the field of physics. The researchers' work is based on a deep understanding of the physical mechanisms behind the motion of sprinklers.

The reverse sprinkler problem has a long history, dating back to the 1960s when Feynman first proposed it as a challenge to his students. The problem is deceptively simple: when a sprinkler is connected to a water supply, it rotates in a certain direction, but when the water supply is reversed, the sprinkler's rotation is expected to reverse as well. However, this is not always the case, and the problem has been the subject of much debate and research over the years. The problem is important not just because of its inherent interest, but also because it has implications for our understanding of the behavior of complex systems. By solving the reverse sprinkler problem, researchers can gain insights into the behavior of other complex systems, such as those found in engineering and biology.

The researchers' solution to the problem is based on a detailed analysis of the physical mechanisms that govern the motion of sprinklers. According to the researchers, the key to understanding the reverse sprinkler problem lies in the interaction between the sprinkler's rotating parts and the water supply. The researchers used a combination of theoretical models and experimental techniques to study the motion of sprinklers under different conditions. Their findings show that the motion of a sprinkler is determined by a complex interplay of factors, including the sprinkler's design, the water pressure, and the friction between the sprinkler's moving parts. The researchers' work provides a detailed and comprehensive explanation of the reverse sprinkler problem, and their findings have been widely praised by the scientific community.

The researchers' work has been widely reported in the media, and their findings have been recognized as a major achievement in the field of physics. The solution to the reverse sprinkler problem is a testament to the power of human ingenuity and the importance of basic scientific research.

The solution to the reverse sprinkler problem is part of a broader trend in physics research, which is focused on understanding the behavior of complex systems. items.story:
A Tesla driver involved in a fatal crash in Texas last month pressed the accelerator pedal 100% in the moments leading up to the accident, according to a confirmation by the National Transportation Safety Board. The incident occurred when the Tesla vehicle, which was reportedly operating with its advanced driver assistance system engaged, crashed into a tree, resulting in the deaths of two occupants. The NTSB's confirmation supports Tesla's account of the crash, which the company shared publicly days after the incident. This development is significant as it sheds more light on the circumstances surrounding the fatal accident.

The crash has sparked renewed debate about the safety and reliability of advanced driver assistance systems, including Tesla's Autopilot feature. Tesla has consistently maintained that its Autopilot system is designed to assist drivers, but not replace them, and that drivers must remain attentive and engaged at all times when using the feature. The company has also emphasized that the system is not capable of fully autonomous driving and requires constant human oversight. The incident in Texas is one of several recent accidents involving Tesla vehicles operating with Autopilot engaged, raising concerns about the potential risks associated with these systems.

According to the NTSB, data from the Tesla vehicle's onboard computer indicates that the driver pressed the accelerator pedal to 100% in the seconds preceding the crash, despite the presence of a tree in the vehicle's path. The NTSB's findings are based on a preliminary analysis of the data, which also shows that the vehicle's Autopilot system was engaged at the time of the crash. Tesla has stated that the Autopilot system is designed to detect and respond to obstacles, but the company has not commented on why the system failed to prevent the accident in this instance. The NTSB's investigation is ongoing, and the agency is expected to release a more detailed report on the crash in the coming months.

The confirmation of the Tesla driver's actions has been met with concern from safety advocates, who argue that the incident highlights the need for more stringent regulations and oversight of advanced driver assistance systems. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has also launched an investigation into the crash, and the agency is expected to examine the role of Tesla's Autopilot system in the accident. The incident has also sparked a reaction from lawmakers, with some calling for greater transparency and accountability from manufacturers of autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicles.

The incident in Texas is part of a broader conversation about the safety and regulation of advanced driver assistance systems, which are becoming increasingly common in modern vehicles. As the technology continues to evolve, there are growing concerns about the potential risks and unintended consequences of these systems, particularly in situations where drivers may become overly reliant on them. The NTSB's investigation into the Tesla crash is likely to inform broader discussions about the need for more robust safety protocols and regulations governing the development and deployment of autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicles.

As the investigation into the Tesla crash continues, the company is likely to face increased scrutiny over the safety and reliability of its Autopilot system. Tesla has consistently maintained that the system is safe and effective when used as intended, but the incident in Texas has raised questions about the potential risks associated with the technology. The company is expected to release more detailed information about the crash and the role of the Autopilot system in the coming weeks, and regulators are likely to examine the incident closely as they consider new rules and guidelines for the development and deployment of autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicles.

items.headline: Punjab's electoral landscape haunted by historical grievances and unresolved regional tensions.
items.teaser: Punjab's political landscape is abuzz with activity as the state gears up for upcoming elections, with leaders like Channi and issues lik…
items.story:
Punjab's political landscape is abuzz with activity as the state gears up for upcoming elections, with leaders like Channi and issues like the Satluj river dominating the discourse, serving as a reminder of the region's complex past. The state's history of political upheaval and social unrest has made it a challenging terrain for parties to navigate. As the election season approaches, parties are being cautious in their approach, aware of the potential pitfalls that could impact their prospects. With the ghost of past controversies still looming large, parties are treading carefully to avoid alienating key voter groups.

The Satluj river, which has been a longstanding point of contention between Punjab and its neighboring states, continues to be a sensitive issue, with parties walking a tightrope to balance the interests of various stakeholders. The river's water sharing agreements have been a source of tension, with Punjab asserting its rights to the water while other states have their own claims. This complex web of interests has made it essential for parties to approach the issue with caution, lest they be seen as compromising the state's interests. The region's history of political instability has also made it crucial for parties to be mindful of the potential consequences of their actions.

Official statements from party leaders have emphasized the need for a balanced approach, with Channi and other prominent leaders calling for a solution that takes into account the interests of all stakeholders. Experts have also weighed in, highlighting the need for a comprehensive framework that addresses the concerns of all parties involved. Data suggests that the Satluj river is a critical component of Punjab's economy, with the state's agricultural sector heavily reliant on its waters. As such, any decision regarding the river's water sharing agreements is likely to have significant implications for the state's economy and the livelihoods of its people.

The reactions of various stakeholders to the ongoing developments have been mixed, with some groups expressing support for the cautious approach adopted by parties while others have criticized it as inadequate. Farmers' organizations, in particular, have been vocal in their demands for a more assertive stance on the Satluj river issue, citing the critical importance of the river's waters for their livelihoods. Meanwhile, opposition parties have sought to capitalize on the issue, accusing the ruling party of failing to protect the state's interests. As the election season heats up, the Satluj river issue is likely to remain a contentious point, with parties seeking to outmaneuver each other in their bid to win over voters.

The wider context of the Satluj river issue is also significant, with implications extending beyond Punjab's borders to the broader region. The river's water sharing agreements have been a point of contention between multiple states, with the potential for conflict simmering just below the surface. As such, any decision regarding the river's waters is likely to have far-reaching consequences, impacting not just Punjab but also neighboring states. Regional stability and cooperation are critical in this context, with parties and governments needing to work together to find a solution that balances the interests of all stakeholders.

As the election season approaches, all eyes will be on how parties navigate the complex web of issues surrounding the Satluj river and Punjab's past. With the stakes high and the potential for controversy significant, parties will need to tread carefully to avoid missteps that could damage their prospects. The coming weeks and months will be critical, with parties seeking to establish a clear narrative on the Satluj river issue and other key concerns, and voters weighing their options carefully before casting their ballots. As the situation unfolds, it remains to be seen how parties will balance their competing interests and priorities, and what the ultimate outcome will be for Punjab and its people.

This development affects thousands of Indian nationals who have been residing and working in the U.K. for various periods. The India-U.K. Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement, which came into effect on July 15, 2026, aims to strengthen economic ties between the two nations. The agreement's provisions have been closely watched by businesses, policymakers, and individuals on both sides.

The India-U.K. Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement marks a significant milestone in the bilateral relationship between the two countries, building on a long history of trade and cultural exchange. The agreement is expected to increase trade volumes, promote investment, and create new opportunities for businesses and individuals alike. The dispute settlement mechanism is a key component of the agreement, providing a framework for resolving trade-related disputes and promoting cooperation between the two nations. The clarification regarding the applicability of the mechanism to Indian workers in the U.K. prior to July 15, 2026, is crucial for understanding the agreement's implications.

According to official statements, the dispute settlement mechanism is designed to provide a fair and transparent process for resolving trade-related disputes, with a focus on cooperation and mutual understanding. The mechanism will be overseen by a joint committee comprising representatives from both countries, who will work together to resolve disputes and promote trade facilitation. Indian officials have emphasized that the agreement will benefit Indian businesses and workers, while U.K. officials have highlighted the potential for increased trade and investment. The exact number of Indian workers affected by the clarification is not yet known, but estimates suggest that thousands of individuals may be impacted.

The clarification has sparked mixed reactions from stakeholders, with some expressing concerns about the potential impact on Indian workers in the U.K. who may not be eligible for the dispute settlement mechanism. Others have welcomed the agreement, citing its potential to promote trade and investment between the two nations. Indian business leaders have urged the government to provide more information about the agreement's provisions and how they will be implemented. Meanwhile, U.K. officials have emphasized the importance of the agreement in promoting economic cooperation and trade facilitation.

The India-U.K. Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement has significant implications for the regional and global economy, as it marks a major step forward in bilateral trade relations between the two nations. The agreement is expected to have a positive impact on trade volumes, with estimates suggesting that bilateral trade could increase significantly in the coming years. The agreement may also have implications for other countries in the region, as it sets a precedent for future trade agreements and cooperation mechanisms. As the agreement is implemented, policymakers and businesses will be watching closely to see how it affects trade flows and economic cooperation between India and the U.K.

As the India-U.K. Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement begins to take shape, several key questions remain unanswered, including how the dispute settlement mechanism will be implemented in practice and what support will be provided to Indian workers in the U.K. who are not eligible for the mechanism. Officials from both countries are expected to meet in the coming weeks to discuss the agreement's implementation and address any concerns or questions that may arise. Meanwhile, businesses and individuals are eagerly awaiting more information about the agreement's provisions and how they will be affected by the new trade regime.

India is one of the world's largest consumers of urea, and the demand for the fertilizer has been increasing steadily over the years. However, the country's domestic production has not been able to keep pace with demand, resulting in a significant reliance on imports. The government has been working to address this issue by promoting the use of alternative fertilizers and increasing domestic production, and the new policy is a key part of those efforts. The policy is also expected to help reduce the country's subsidy burden, which has been a major concern for the government.

According to official sources, the new policy will provide a range of incentives to encourage the setting up of gas-based urea manufacturing plants, including subsidies and tax breaks. items.story: യുഎസ്, ചൈനീസ് സഹായമൊന്നും വേണ്ട, ഇത് ഇന്ത്യയുടെ സ്വന്തം സാങ്കേതികത; വയറുകളിൽ കുരുങ്ങാതെ കുതിക്കാൻ ‘നമോ ഗ്രീൻ’; ലോക റെക്കോർഡും നമുക്ക് സ്വന്തം Manorama Onlineചരിത്രപരമായ കുതിപ്പിന് ഒരുങ്ങി രാജ്യം, ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ആദ്യ ഹൈഡ്രജൻ ട്രെയിൻ ജൂലൈ 17 ന്; പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി ഫ്ലാഗ് ഓഫ് ചെയ്യും Asianet News Malayalamഹൈഡ്രജൻ ഇന്ധനമായ ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ആദ്യ ട്രെയിൻ ഹരിയാനയിൽ നാളെ പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി ഉദ്ഘാടനം ചെയ്യും Mathrubhumiപുകയ്ക്ക് പകരം വെള്ളവും നീരാവിയും! ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ആദ്യ ഹൈഡ്രജൻ ട്രെയിന്റെ അത്ഭുത ശാസ്ത്രം അറിയാം Oneindia Malay

items.story: E20 അടിച്ചതോടെ വാഹനം സ്ഥിരം കട്ടപ്പുറത്ത്; പുതിയ കാർ നൽകാൻ ഉത്തരവിട്ട് കോടതി; അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പണം നൽകണം Reporter TvE20 പെട്രോളുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട ആദ്യ കേസ്; വാഹനം മാറ്റിനൽകാൻ ഉത്തരവ്, ഉടമയ്ക്ക് അനുകൂല വിധി Mathrubhumiഇ20 പദ്ധതിയില്‍ നിന്നും പിന്നോട്ടില്ല; ഉപഭോക്താക്കളുടെ ആശങ്കകള്‍ പരിഹരിക്കും ഫ്‌ളക്‌സ് ഫ്യുവല്‍ Manorama Onlineഇ20 പെട്രോൾ വില്ലനോ? വാഹന ഉടമയ്ക്ക് അനുകൂലമായി ആദ്യ ഉപഭോക്തൃ കോടതി വിധി manoramanews.comഇ 20 ഇന്ധനം ഉപയോഗിച്ച് വാഹനത്തിന് കേടുപാട്; ഉടമയ്ക്ക് നഷ്ടപരിഹാരവും കോടതിച്ചെലവും നൽകാൻ ഉത്

items.story: ദീദിയെ കൈവിട്ട് കോയൽ മല്ലിക്, തൃണമൂൽ ക്യാംപിനെ ഞെട്ടിച്ച് ബംഗാളി നടി; എംപി സ്ഥാനം ഒഴിഞ്ഞു Manorama Onlineതൃണമൂൽ കോൺഗ്രസിന് വീണ്ടും തിരിച്ചടി; രാജ്യസഭാംഗത്വം രാജിവെച്ച് ബംഗാളി നടി കോയൽ മല്ലിക് | Madhyamam Madhyamamമമതയ്ക്ക് വീണ്ടും തിരിച്ചടി: മുറിയേ മാറിയിട്ടുള്ളൂ, വീട്‌ മാറിയില്ലെന്ന് മിത്ര; ഇനി വിമതക്യാമ്പിൽ Mathrubhumiമമതാ ബാനർജിക്ക് വീണ്ടും തിരിച്ചടി; തൃണമൂൽ കോൺഗ്രസ് എംപി കോയൽ മല്ലിക്ക് രാജിവെച്ചു, രാജിക്കത്ത് സമർപ്പിച്ചു Asianet News Malayalamമമത ബാനർജിക്ക് വീണ്ടും തിരിച്ചടി; മുതിർന്ന നേതാവ്

items.teaser: യുഎസ്, ചൈനീസ് സഹായമൊന്നും വേണ്ട, ഇത് ഇന്ത്യയുടെ സ്വന്തം സാങ്കേതികത; വയറുകളിൽ കുരുങ്ങാതെ കുതിക്കാൻ ‘നമോ ഗ്രീൻ’; ലോക റെക്കോർഡും നമുക്ക് സ്വ…
items.story: യുഎസ്, ചൈനീസ് സഹായമൊന്നും വേണ്ട, ഇത് ഇന്ത്യയുടെ സ്വന്തം സാങ്കേതികത; വയറുകളിൽ കുരുങ്ങാതെ കുതിക്കാൻ ‘നമോ ഗ്രീൻ’; ലോക റെക്കോർഡും നമുക്ക് സ്വന്തം Manorama Onlineചരിത്രപരമായ കുതിപ്പിന് ഒരുങ്ങി രാജ്യം, ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ആദ്യ ഹൈഡ്രജൻ ട്രെയിൻ ജൂലൈ 17 ന്; പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി ഫ്ലാഗ് ഓഫ് ചെയ്യും Asianet News Malayalamഹൈഡ്രജൻ ഇന്ധനമായ ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ആദ്യ ട്രെയിൻ ഹരിയാനയിൽ നാളെ പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി ഉദ്ഘാടനം ചെയ്യും Mathrubhumiപുകയ്ക്ക് പകരം വെള്ളവും നീരാവിയും! ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ആദ്യ ഹൈഡ്രജൻ ട്രെയിന്റെ അത്ഭുത ശാസ്ത്രം അറിയാം Oneindia Malay

items.story: മണ്ഡല പുനർനിർണയത്തിൽ തട്ടി ഇന്ത്യാ സഖ്യം ഉലയുന്നോ? ബിജെപിയുടെ തന്ത്രങ്ങളിൽ വലഞ്ഞ് കോൺഗ്രസ് Mathrubhumi‘ലോക്സഭാ, നിയമസഭാ സീറ്റുകൾ 50 ശതമാനം വർധിപ്പിക്കണം’; മണ്ഡല പുനർനിർണയ ബില്ലിനെ പിന്തുണയ്ക്കാൻ ഉപാധിയുമായി എൻസിപി Manorama Onlineഇന്ത്യാ മുന്നണിയെ കൈവിടുമോ എൻസിപി(എസ്പി)? ഒറ്റ നിബന്ധന അം​ഗീകരിച്ചാൽ മണ്ഡല പുനർനിർണയ ബില്ലിനെ പിന്തുണക്കുമെന്ന് സുപ്രിയ Asianet News Malayalamമണ്ഡല പുനർനിർണയ ബില്ലിനെ പവാർ പക്ഷം പിന്തുണച്ചേക്കുമെന്ന് റിപ്പോർട്ട്; അഭ്യൂഹമെന്ന് സുപ്രിയ | Madhyamam Madhyamamവനിതാ സംവരണ ഭേദഗ

items.story: ഒന്നാം സമ്മാനം 30 കോടി രൂപ; തിരുവോണം ബംബര്‍ ടിക്കറ്റ് വില്‍പ്പന തിങ്കളാഴ്ച മുതല്‍ Marunadan Malayaliഅടിച്ചാൽ 30 കോടി; തിരുവോണം ബംപർ പുറത്തിറക്കി, തിങ്കളാഴ്ച വിൽപനയ്ക്ക് എത്തും Manorama Onlineചരിത്രത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും ഉയർന്ന സമ്മാനത്തുകയുമായി ഭാ​ഗ്യക്കുറി വകുപ്പ്; വിലയിൽ മാറ്റമില്ല, വിൽപന 20 തിങ്കളാഴ്ച മുതൽ, ഒന്നാം സമ്മാനം 30 കോടി രൂപ Asianet News Malayalamഒന്നാം സമ്മാനം 30 കോടി; ചരിത്രത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും ഉയർന്ന സമ്മാനത്തുകയുമായി ഓണം ബംപർ Deepika Newsഇത്തവണ ഓണംലോട്ടറി തകര്‍ക്കും ; തിരുവോണം ബമ്പറിന് സമ്മാനത

items.story: കൈക്കൂലി തടയൽ: വിജയി ഇറക്കിയ 'നമ്പരിൽ' വീണത് ടിവികെ നേതാവ്, വാങ്ങിയത് 30,000 രൂപ Manorama Onlineകൈക്കൂലി തടയാൻ വിജയ് സർക്കാർ ഹെൽപ്പ് ലൈൻ നമ്പർ പുറത്തുവിട്ടു, പിന്നാലെ കുടുങ്ങിയത് ടിവികെ നേതാവ് Kerala Kaumudiകരാറുകാരനിൽ നിന്ന് 1.30 ലക്ഷം രൂപ കൈക്കൂലി വാങ്ങിയ നേതാവിനെ ടിവികെ പുറത്താക്കി News18 Malayalamഅഴിമതിയാരോപണത്തിൽ കുടുങ്ങി ടിവികെയും News Malayalam 24x7കൈക്കൂലി വച്ചുപൊറുപ്പിക്കില്ലെന്ന് വിജയ്; പിന്നാലെ ടിവികെ പ്രവർത്തകന്റെ കൈക്കൂലി വീഡിയോ, നടപടി Oneindia Malayalam

items.story: An existing constipation drug may have an unexpected new use: helping clear the "brain fog" that often lingers after depression. In a small clinical trial, people with a history of depression who took the medication prucalopride for about a week performed better on tests of memory, attention, and thinking speed than those who received a placebo. The drug targets a serotonin receptor found in both the gut and the brain, and researchers saw no significant side effects.
